item.title: SDP Leaders Receive Body of Late Senator Godiya Akwashiki in Abuja
item.description: Senior leaders of the Social Democratic Party (SDP) on Monday received the remains of Senator Godiya Akwashiki at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja, following his death last week in India.Prominent figures present included the party's 2023 presidential candidate, Prince Adewole Adebayo; former Nasarawa State Governor Umaru Tanko Al-Makura; lawmakers; and supporters. item.title: US invasion: Venezuela’s allies left Maduro exposed to adversaries – Bashir Ahmad
item.description: Former presidential aide, Bashir Ahmad, says the allies of Venezuela left its leadership isolated, exposed, and alone in the hands of its adversaries. item.title: Maduro appears before US court on weapons, drug trafficking charges
item.description: Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro appeared in a New York court on Monday, two days after he was whisked away by the United States special forces in a military operation in Caracas. Images showed an armoured vehicle carrying Maduro and his arriving at the courthouse earlier. Maduro is facing four counts relating to alleged drugs and weapons possession and trafficking. item.title: TEAM LIST: Onyedika, Chuwkwueze benched as Chelle names familiar starting XI against Mozambique
item.description: Eric Chelle, Super Eagles head coach, has reverted to a familiar starting line-up for the team’s second round game against Mozambique at the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON). The Franco-Malian coach makes eight changes to the rotated team that defeated Uganda 3-1 in the final Group C match.
